124.name: Pickpocket
124.description: Steals an item when hit by another Pokémon.

125.name: Sheer Force
125.description: Removes added effects to increase move damage.

126.name: Contrary
126.description: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

127.name: Unnerve
127.description: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.

128.name: Defiant
128.description: When its stats are lowered its Attack increases.

129.name: Defeatist
129.description: Lowers stats when HP becomes half or less.

130.name: Cursed Body
130.description: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.

131.name: Healer
131.description: May heal an ally's status conditions.

133.name: Weak Armor
133.description: Physical attacks lower Defense and raise Speed.

136.name: Multiscale
136.description: Reduces damage when HP is full.

137.name: Toxic Boost
137.description: Powers up physical attacks when poisoned.

138.name: Flare Boost
138.description: Powers up special attacks when burned.

139.name: Harvest
139.description: May create another Berry after one is used.

140.name: Telepathy
140.description: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.

141.name: Moody
141.description: Raises one stat and lowers another.

142.name: Overcoat
142.description: Protects the Pokémon from damage from weather.

143.name: Poison Touch
143.description: May poison targets when a Pokémon makes contact.

144.name: Regenerator
144.description: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

145.name: Big Pecks
145.description: Protects the Pokémon from Defense-lowering attacks.

146.name: Sand Rush
146.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in a sandstorm.

147.name: Wonder Skin
147.description: Makes status-changing moves more likely to miss.

148.name: Analytic
148.description: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

149.name: Illusion
149.description: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in back.

150.name: Imposter
150.description: It transforms itself into the Pokémon it is facing.

151.name: Infiltrator
151.description: Passes through the foe's barrier and strikes.

152.name: Mummy
152.description: Contact with this Pokémon spreads this Ability.

153.name: Moxie
153.description: Boosts Attack after knocking out any Pokémon.

154.name: Justified
154.description: Raises Attack when hit by a Dark-type move.

155.name: Rattled
155.description: Some move types scare it and boost its Speed.

157.name: Sap Sipper
157.description: Boosts Attack when hit by a Grass-type move.

158.name: Prankster
158.description: Gives priority to a status move.

159.name: Sand Force
159.description: Boosts certain moves' power in a sandstorm.

160.name: Iron Barbs
160.description: Inflicts damage to the Pokémon on contact.

161.name: Zen Mode
161.description: Changes the Pokémon's shape when HP is halved.

162.name: Victory Star
162.description: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

163.name: Turboblaze
163.description: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.

164.name: Teravolt
164.description: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.
